name: 2 John
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: The author calls himself “the elder,” and tradition identifies him with John.
setting: Written to “the elect lady and her children.”
theme: Walk in truth and love, and avoid false teachers.

outline.label: The elder to the elect lady

christInBook: John warns against those who do not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh (v. 7). The true teaching about Christ is the center of the letter.
howToRead: 2 John is one page. Notice how it holds together truth and love, and how it warns against welcoming teachers who deny Christ.
